# Where audit events are validated, and who calls it

## The schema

`AuditEventSchema` (the Zod schema all audit events are validated against) is
defined in `packages/shared/src/schemas.ts:40-52`, alongside `AuditActionSchema`
(the enum of allowed `action` values) and the `AuditEvent` type inferred from it.

## Validation sites

There are four places in the codebase that actually call `AuditEventSchema.parse(...)`:

1. **`packages/sidecar/src/audit.ts:18`** — `AuditWriter.write(event)`
   Validates an event before appending it as a line to `audit.jsonl`. Per the
   module comment, this is the append-only writer; every transformation is
   expected to write here.

2. **`packages/sidecar/src/store.ts:168`** — `Store.insertAuditEvent(event)`
   Validates before inserting the event into the SQLite `audit` table.

3. **`packages/sidecar/src/store.ts:190`** — `Store.listAuditEvents(sessionId)`
   Re-validates each row read back out of the `audit` table before returning it.

4. **`packages/shared/src/audit-file.ts:23`** — `readAuditFile(filePath, sessionId?)`
   Validates each line parsed out of `audit.jsonl`. Unlike the others, this one
   is tolerant of failures: a line that fails validation is counted in
   `malformed` rather than throwing.

Note that writing an audit event always goes through **both** #1 and #2 (the
sidecar keeps the JSONL file and the SQLite table in sync), so every real event
is validated twice on the way in.

## Callers

### Of `AuditWriter.write` / `Store.insertAuditEvent` (write path)

Production call sites always call both together, back to back:

- **`packages/sidecar/src/serve.ts:70-71`** — `serveFile()`, which records an
  audit event every time a file is served (full/diff/unchanged). Called from
  the `/serve-file` HTTP handler in `packages/sidecar/src/daemon.ts:95`.
- **`packages/sidecar/src/distill.ts:273-274`** — inside `distillArtifact()`.
  Called from the `/serve-file` and `/distill` HTTP handlers in
  `packages/sidecar/src/daemon.ts:105` and `:141`.
- **`packages/sidecar/src/distill.ts:319-320`** — inside `zoom()`. Called from
  the `/zoom` HTTP handler in `packages/sidecar/src/daemon.ts:133`.
- **`packages/sidecar/src/redact.ts:96-97`** — inside
  `storeRedactedArtifact()`, which is itself called from
  `distillArtifact()` (`packages/sidecar/src/distill.ts:239`), so it's reached
  via the same `/serve-file` and `/distill` daemon routes whenever redaction
  finds something to flag.

Test-only callers: `packages/sidecar/test/audit.test.ts`,
`packages/sidecar/test/redact.test.ts`, `packages/sidecar/test/serve.test.ts`,
and `packages/sidecar/test/store.test.ts` construct `AuditWriter`/`Store`
directly and call `write`/`insertAuditEvent` to exercise validation
(e.g. `audit.test.ts:40` asserts an invalid `action` throws).

### Of `readAuditFile` (read path)

- **`packages/meter/src/audit-render.ts:30`** — `buildAuditReport()`, called by
  `packages/meter/src/cli.ts:124` (the meter CLI's audit-report command) and by
  `packages/meter/src/report.ts:9` (imports `buildAuditReport` for the report
  builder).
- **`packages/meter/src/receipt.ts:62`** — used when building a session
  receipt, to pull the audit trail for a given session.

Test-only callers: `packages/sidecar/test/codex.test.ts`,
`packages/sidecar/test/audit.test.ts`, `packages/sidecar/test/redact.test.ts`,
`packages/sidecar/test/serve.test.ts`, `packages/meter/test/e2e-smoke.test.ts`.

## Summary of the call chain

```
AuditEventSchema (packages/shared/src/schemas.ts:40)
  ├─ used by AuditWriter.write            (sidecar/src/audit.ts:18)
  │    ├─ serveFile                       (sidecar/src/serve.ts)      ← daemon POST /serve-file
  │    ├─ distillArtifact                 (sidecar/src/distill.ts)   ← daemon POST /serve-file, /distill
  │    ├─ zoom                            (sidecar/src/distill.ts)   ← daemon POST /zoom
  │    └─ storeRedactedArtifact           (sidecar/src/redact.ts)    ← called from distillArtifact
  ├─ used by Store.insertAuditEvent       (sidecar/src/store.ts:168) ← same call sites as above, paired 1:1
  ├─ used by Store.listAuditEvents        (sidecar/src/store.ts:190) ← (no non-test callers found)
  └─ used by readAuditFile                (shared/src/audit-file.ts:23)
       ├─ buildAuditReport                (meter/src/audit-render.ts) ← meter CLI (cli.ts), report.ts
       └─ receipt builder                 (meter/src/receipt.ts)
```
